headline: A Texas cop signed on to help ICE deport his neighbors. It tore the town apart.
summary: Local law enforcement officer, Jaron Alexander, is among the 29,000 officers in Texas involved in the Trump administration's deportation efforts.

headline: The ACLU Didn’t Need To Join This Fight
summary: The author of the article has terminated their membership with the national ACLU due to its involvement in a lawsuit against Hawaii's dark money law. This decision reflects growing political tension surrounding campaign finance regulations in the state.

headline: House speaker’s poll: Mississippians want to eliminate property tax even if it means higher retail costs
summary: A Mississippi poll found inflation/cost of living was residents' top priority, yet a majority favored eliminating property taxes on primary residences despite knowing it would increase sales tax on retail items. Speaker Jason White commissioned the poll, and House Republicans are considering the proposal.
